about.heading: Hello! I'm Louis Freeman.

conversation.a: I'm a full-stack engineer working across React/TypeScript and Ruby on Rails on a multi-region fintech platform. I joined Hnry as one of the first two engineers on the UK team and have helped grow it to eight. My work centres on end-to-end ownership of hard integrations: a UK banking and card provider, identity verification across three countries, and HMRC, along with the product surfaces built on top of them.
highlight: one of the first two engineers on the UK team

conversation.a: I line-manage three engineers, run engineering chapter sessions for the wider team, and lead AI engineering for the UK business, working with operations and marketing as well as engineering.
highlight: lead AI engineering for the UK business

conversation.q: How did you get into software?
conversation.a: Before software I studied Product Design & Manufacture Engineering at the University of Nottingham, which still shapes how I think about building things people actually use.

earlier: Led a team of court attendants at the Wimbledon Championships.
Spectator services at the Rio 2016 Olympics.
